== Skins ==
{{Item Skins|Werewolf Helmet}}

== Trivia ==
* {{AN|Regenerative Howl}} does not heal the wearer, only players around them.
* '''Werewolf Armor''' was the first [[Armor]] in the game to directly grant {{Stat|Ferocity}}.
* Excluding Infernal Armor Sets, '''Werewolf Armor''' has the highest amount of essence required to be dungeonized and starred.
** This is followed by the {{Item|Wither Armor}} variants and then {{Item|Holy Dragon Armor}}.

== Tips ==
* Due to the lack of any {{Skl|combat}} requirement, '''Werewolf Armor''' is an alternative to {{Item|Unstable Dragon Armor}} and {{Item|Strong Dragon Armor}} in the early game.
* It also offers a similar DPS to {{Item|Shadow Assassin Armor}} due to its {{stat|ferocity|40}} and {{Legendary}} rarity for reforges.
